title: Make unresolved tribunal findings mechanically block merge and require verified closure
desired_change: Extend Proposed Move typing with hidden-context fields and merge-blocking semantics; add a queue manifest; update CI to validate move instances and fail while any blocking move is not verified with acceptance evidence and a receipt; document GitHub ruleset requirements and prohibit auto-merge or waiver without an authorized receipt.
expected_outcome: The PR cannot merge merely because structural CI is green, a reviewer is tired, or Bryan remembers how the missing parts should work.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Known defects can be merged and become canonical through process drift.

hidden_context_dependencies: The current CI passes despite the PR explicitly listing missing Golden requirements.
Proposed Move schema has no blocks_merge, hidden-context, resolution-artifact, or acceptance-check fields.
No queue instance exists for known blockers.
No required-check or review ruleset is verified.
A move can be marked implemented without a verified receipt or outcome obligation.
acceptance_checks: CI fails while any blocks_merge move is not verified.
Verified blockers require receipt_ref and all acceptance checks to be evidenced.
The PR remains draft and receives a REQUEST_CHANGES tribunal review.
Merge rules require the Ship It Without Bryan check before canon promotion.
